sources.title: The World's Most Competitive Man
sources.quote_checked: I'm addicted to winning. The more you win, the more you want to win. | We're far behind. They're three times bigger than we are. | I admit to it, mea culpa. An awful lot of it is personal vanity. | We're curious about our own limits and we try to discover our own limits.
